verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a government filing service, for example batch annual-report filing or bulk status checks across many entities. The evidence describes only single-entity flows: each filing starts from one Business Entity File Number behind an image CAPTCHA. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec, and nothing documents batch or multi-item operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
